purpose: Provide verifier-backed numerical proof for canonical MathProgram plans without upgrading caller-supplied vector comparison or creating a second math executor.

authority_model.math_program_receipt: wasm_verifier using replayed canonical MathProgram execution as reference
authority_model.direct_operation_receipt: wasm_verifier executes the canonical direct implementation and compares it against an internally constructed one-step MathProgramV9 reference; caller supplies neither reference nor candidate

workspaceBindRuntimeMathProgramPlan.requirement: runtime subject must already be bound
workspaceBindRuntimeMathProgramPlan.identity_source: canonical plan replay programIdentity; caller cannot supply identity string

workspaceVerifyMathProgram1Receipt.mutation: verifier receipt ledger after successful verifier execution

workspaceVerifyMathProgram2Receipt.mutation: verifier receipt ledger after successful verifier execution

workspaceBindRuntimeDirectMathOperation.requirement: runtime subject must already be bound
workspaceBindRuntimeDirectMathOperation.identity_source: canonical operation id + validated params -> internally compiled one-step MathProgramV9 programIdentity

workspaceVerifyDirectMath1Receipt.mutation: verifier receipt ledger after direct execution + independent V9 reference execution + comparison

workspaceVerifyDirectMath2Receipt.mutation: verifier receipt ledger after direct execution + independent V9 reference execution + comparison

plan_dispatch.replay_policy: from_plan must accept the exact canonical plan before execution or binding

input_count_policy.mismatch_policy: fail closed before reference execution and receipt allocation
input_count_policy.v5_note: MathProgram v5 requires 3..8 external inputs, so v5 plans are recognized/replayable for identity but are not executable through the v1 one/two-input verifier surfaces

subject_binding.bound_workspace: exact replay-derived programIdentity must already be registered for the workspace runtime subject
subject_binding.fingerprint_policy: FNV fingerprint is correlation metadata only

direct_target.candidate_execution: verifier invokes the existing canonical direct surface internally
direct_target.reference_execution: verifier builds and runs a one-step MathProgramV9 reference internally
direct_target.subject_binding: subject-bound verification requires the exact internally generated V9 reference programIdentity to be registered through workspaceBindRuntimeDirectMathOperation
direct_target.cosine_policy: explicit epsilon required for verification even though the direct public surface supports a default; verifier never guesses the default
direct_target.shared_kernel_note: direct and MathProgram paths may share underlying Burn numerical kernels; receipt proves path equivalence for the call, not implementation diversity below Burn

invariants: caller cannot inject a verifier receipt or MathProgram identity
programIdentity is derived from canonical plan replay
subject-bound verification fails before reference execution/receipt allocation when exact programIdentity is not bound
MathProgram execution is the reference authority for math-program receipts
numerical mismatch records a failed verifier receipt rather than becoming a transport error
malformed plan, input mismatch, non-finite candidate, or invalid tolerances do not allocate a receipt id
direct-target verification remains lower-authority caller-supplied comparison until a dedicated direct verifier exists
canonical plan declared input count must exactly match the selected verifier surface before reference execution
direct verifier caller cannot supply the candidate output or numerical reference
direct verifier always uses an internally generated one-step MathProgramV9 reference for the same canonical operation and explicit parameters
subject-bound direct verification fails before execution/receipt allocation until the generated reference programIdentity is bound
direct cosine verification requires an explicit epsilon to avoid silently coupling proof semantics to a direct-surface default
direct verifier receipt candidate_authority=burn_direct_math and reference_authority=burn_math_program
direct-vs-program verification proves execution-path equivalence at the math interaction boundary and does not claim independent numerical kernels below Burn
